title: Project overview
transcript:
01 / PROJECT OVERVIEW
FROM MANUAL MINING
TO AI-DRIVEN AUTOMATION.
The player starts by mining ores manually. As 
resources accumulate, they can craft specialised 
robots that automate parts of the mining loop. The 
defining feature is that each robot can receive 
natural-language instructions through a chat 
interface powered by a local Ollama LLM.
MY ROLE
PROGRAMMING +
GAME IMPLEMENTATION
Two-person team. My teammate created 
the robot models. I implemented them in 
Unity and built the gameplay logic, AI 
interaction, robot actions, progression 
systems and UI integration.
2 PERSON TEAM
Pierre Louw - Programmer
Nick Smart - Artist
ENGINE
UNITY
PROJECT BRIEF
Integrate a local LLM model from 
Ollama into any game concept 
and make it meaningfully affect 
gameplay.

title: Natural language becomes gameplay
transcript:
03 / TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHT
NATURAL LANGUAGE
BECOMES GAMEPLAY.
Instead of choosing from a fixed command menu, the 
player can type an instruction to a robot. A local Ollama 
model interprets the request and returns structured JSON. 
Unity then parses that response and converts it into 
actions the robot can execute.

title: The robots
transcript:
04 / THE ROBOTS
THREE ROBOTS.
THREE SPECIALISED ROLES.
MINING ROBOT
The mining robot extracts ores 
from rocks much faster and  
more efficient than you. It also 
has the ability to mine some 
ores that the player is not able 
to extract themself.
COLLECTION ROBOT
The collection robot supports 
your mining robots as they can 
follow any mining robot and 
collect the ores that are 
mined. Once full, you can tell it 
to deliver their inventory into a 
specific chest.
SCANNING ROBOT
The scanning robot scans the 
area for ore rocks so that the 
other robots are able to see 
them. The ore rocks within the 
scan area appear with their 
icons above them.
